defects_found_and_fixed_on_the_way: canonical_id had no index: every MCP seed resolution scanned nodes twice (18 ms each on the repository graph)
SQLite 3.53 (modernc) planned the FindSymbol suffix OR predicate as a full scan (30 ms); now a UNION of two indexed lookups. Seed resolution for every MCP tool: 64 ms -> 0.1 ms
review statement lookup chose idx_edges_type (67 ms); fixed with +e.type
caller walk chose idx_nodes_type for long IN lists (about 240 ms per review on go-stablenet); fixed with +n.type, plus a 2,000-caller budget reported as caller_walk_truncated
